Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 PM HST Sun Nov 01 2026

For the central North Pacific...between 140W and 180W:

Well Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands:
A broad area of low pressure is forecast to develop well to the
southeast of the Hawaiian Islands in a couple of days. Thereafter,
environmental conditions appear generally favorable for gradual
development of this system, and a tropical depression could form
late this week as it moves westward to west-northwestward over the
Central Pacific basin.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.
